APPROVED Building Lot, 25+/- acres of Whitetail Haven in Prime Southern Erie County Location
Discover a hidden gem of a hunting property perfectly situated between Eden, Evans, North Collins, and Angola—an ideal spot for a secluded dream home offering both convenient access and exceptional whitetail opportunities. This is where trophy dreams meet total privacy.
With a long history of producing mature, 150-class bucks, this property has been a family treasure for generations. Thanks to a single point of access, hunters have enjoyed unmatched seclusion and quiet during their hunts—rarely interrupted and full of success.
The land is thoughtfully designed for wildlife: established food plots and a large agricultural field along the western boundary provide abundant food sources, complemented by natural browse throughout the property. The diverse mix of forest—including early successional growth—creates ideal bedding and security cover for deer.
During the agent’s tour, signs of heavy deer activity were unmistakable, with countless tracks and rubs confirming the property’s thriving whitetail population.
Additionally, a gas well on-site offers a clear road access into the parcel
Whether you’re seeking your next trophy, a weekend escape, or a legacy hunting retreat, this property embodies the very best of rural Western New York’s whitetail country. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: Timber and GMO rights convey,   2.5 miles to Eden, 4.1 miles to Angola, 7.4 miles to North Collins, 7.3 miles to Hamburg. Taxes TBD post subdivision, subdivision based on town approval.
Buyer agent must be present on all showings. Do not send clients out without accompanying them.
